                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body cache result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">前言</h2>
<p>在前端开发中，ECharts 作为数据可视化的利器被广泛使用，但每次使用都要重复处理初始化、容器获取、事件绑定、窗口 resize 等逻辑，不仅繁琐还容易出错。最近我封装了一个<code>useEchart</code>&nbsp;Hooks，彻底解决了这些痛点，今天就来分享一下实现思路和使用技巧。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">为什么需要这个 Hooks？</h2>
<p>先看看我们平时用 ECharts 的常规操作：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">
<span class="hljs-comment">// 常规写法</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> chart = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> dom = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'chart-container'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (dom) {
    chart = echarts.<span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>(dom);
    chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">setOption</span>(option);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, handleResize);
  }
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 更新数据</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateChart</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">newData</span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (chart) {
    chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">setOption</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">series</span>: [{ <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: newData }] });
  }
};

<span class="hljs-comment">// 处理resize</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleResize</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">resize</span>();
};

<span class="hljs-comment">// 销毁实例</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">onBeforeUnmount</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, handleResize);
  chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">dispose</span>();
});
</code></pre>
<p>这段代码不算复杂，但每个图表都要写一遍就很折磨人了。更麻烦的是：</p>
<ul>
<li>容器获取要处理各种情况（DOM 元素、ID 选择器、Vue Ref）</li>
<li>频繁初始化容易导致内存泄漏</li>
<li>事件绑定 / 解绑需要手动管理</li>
<li>响应式数据更新要手动触发 setOption</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">useEchart Hooks 来了！</h2>
<p>基于以上痛点，我封装了<code>useEchart</code>&nbsp;Hooks，核心功能包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>支持多种容器类型（Ref、DOM 元素、ID / 类选择器）</li>
<li>自动处理初始化与销毁</li>
<li>响应式配置更新</li>
<li>内置事件绑定 / 解绑方法</li>
<li>自动监听窗口 resize</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">废话不多说先上代码！</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">//先导入Echart</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { echarts } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"@/Echarts"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RefObject</span> {
  current?: <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CallbackRef</span> {
  (<span class="hljs-attr">el</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EchartsOption</span> = echarts.<span class="hljs-property">EChartsOption</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> container =
  | <span class="hljs-title class_">Ref</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt;
  | <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span>
  | <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  | <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>[];

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 适配多种容器选择方式的 ECharts 封装
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> <span class="hljs-variable">container</span> - 容器选择器（支持 Ref, DOM 元素, ID 选择器, 类选择器）
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> <span class="hljs-variable">option</span> - 初始配置
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@returns</span> {<span class="hljs-type">chart: echarts.ECharts | null, update: (newOption: EChartsOption) =&gt; void</span>}
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useEchart</span>(<span class="hljs-params">
  container: container,
  option: EchartsOption = {}
</span>): {
  <span class="hljs-attr">chart</span>: echarts.<span class="hljs-property">ECharts</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">onChartEvent</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, handler: (params: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">offChartEvent</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, handler: (params: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">update</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">newOption: EchartsOption</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">handleResize</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
} {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">chart</span>: echarts.<span class="hljs-property">ECharts</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">containerElement</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">resizeObserver</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ResizeObserver</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">//ResizeObserver 实例</span>

  <span class="hljs-comment">//   辅助函数处理单个选择器</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> getContainerElementForSingle = (
    <span class="hljs-attr">selector</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  ): <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">null</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (selector.<span class="hljs-title function_">startsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"#"</span>)) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(selector.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)) || <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (selector.<span class="hljs-title function_">startsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"."</span>)) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(selector) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span>) || <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    }
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 直接ID 无#</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(selector) || <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  };

  <span class="hljs-comment">//获取容器元素</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> getContainerElement = (): <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">null</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (container <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> container;
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> container === <span class="hljs-string">"string"</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElementForSingle</span>(container);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-string">"value"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> container) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// Ref 类型</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> container.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>;
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">isArray</span>(container)) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 多个选择器（返回第一个匹配）</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> selector <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> container) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> element = <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElementForSingle</span>(selector);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (element) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> element;
        }
      }
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  };

  <span class="hljs-comment">//   初始化图表</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> initChart = (): <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">void</span> =&gt;</span> {
    containerElement = <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElement</span>();

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!containerElement) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"无法获取容器元素"</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!chart) {
      chart = echarts.<span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>(containerElement, <span class="hljs-string">"infographic"</span>);
      resizeObserver = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ResizeObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
        chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">resize</span>();
      });
      resizeObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(containerElement);
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (option) {
      chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">setOption</span>(option);
    }
  };

  <span class="hljs-comment">//   处理窗口大小变化</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleResize</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">resize</span>();
  };

  <span class="hljs-comment">//   更新图表配置</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> update = (<span class="hljs-attr">newOption</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">EchartsOption</span>): <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">void</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (chart) {
      chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">setOption</span>(newOption);
    }
  };
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 新增：事件绑定方法</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onChartEvent</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">event: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, handler: (params: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) =&gt; {
    chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(event, handler);
  };

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">offChartEvent</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">event: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, handler: (params: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) =&gt; {
    chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">off</span>(event, handler);
  };
  <span class="hljs-comment">//   响应式更新图表配置</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">watch</span>(
    <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> option,
    <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">newOption</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(newOption),
    {
      <span class="hljs-attr">deep</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
    }
  );

  <span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">initChart</span>();
  });

  <span class="hljs-title function_">onBeforeUnmount</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (chart) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 清理 ResizeObserver 实例</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resizeObserver) {
        resizeObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>();
        resizeObserver = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
      }
      chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">dispose</span>();
      chart = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    }
  });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">get</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">chart</span>() {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> chart;
    },
    onChartEvent,
    offChartEvent,
    update,
    handleResize
  };
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">核心代码解析</h3>
<p>先看整体结构，这个 Hooks 主要包含这些部分：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useEchart</span>(<span class="hljs-params">container, option</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> chart = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> containerElement = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 容器获取逻辑</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElement</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; { ... };

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化图表</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">initChart</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; { ... };

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 响应式更新</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">watch</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> option, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">newOption</span>) =&gt;</span> { ... });

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 生命周期管理</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">initChart</span>());
  <span class="hljs-title function_">onBeforeUnmount</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> { ... });

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 暴露API</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { chart, update, onChartEvent, offChartEvent, handleResize };
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">1. 万能容器处理</h4>
<p>最实用的功能之一就是支持多种容器形式：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// 支持的容器类型</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> container = <span class="hljs-title class_">Ref</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt; | <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> | <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> | <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>[];

<span class="hljs-comment">// 容器获取逻辑</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElement</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (container <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> container;
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> container === <span class="hljs-string">"string"</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElementForSingle</span>(container);
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-string">"value"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> container) { <span class="hljs-comment">// Vue Ref</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> container.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>;
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">isArray</span>(container)) { <span class="hljs-comment">// 多个选择器</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> selector <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> container) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> element = <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElementForSingle</span>(selector);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (element) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> element;
    }
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
};
</code></pre>
<p>无论是直接传 DOM 元素、Vue 的 Ref 对象，还是 ID 选择器（带 #或不带）、类选择器，甚至是选择器数组（自动取第一个匹配项），都能轻松处理。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">2. 自动生命周期管理</h4>
<p>初始化逻辑会在组件挂载时执行，销毁时自动清理：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化图表</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">initChart</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  containerElement = <span class="hljs-title function_">getContainerElement</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!containerElement) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"无法获取容器元素"</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!chart) {
    chart = echarts.<span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>(containerElement, <span class="hljs-string">"infographic"</span>);
    chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">resize</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"resize"</span>, handleResize);
  }
  chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">setOption</span>(option);
};

<span class="hljs-comment">// 组件卸载时清理</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">onBeforeUnmount</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (chart) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"resize"</span>, handleResize);
    chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">dispose</span>();
    chart = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  }
});
</code></pre>
<p>再也不用担心忘记解绑事件或销毁实例导致的内存泄漏了！</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">3. 响应式与事件处理</h4>
<p>内置 watch 监听配置变化，自动更新图表：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// 响应式更新图表配置</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">watch</span>(
  <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> option,
  <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">newOption</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(newOption),
  { <span class="hljs-attr">deep</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> }
);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 事件绑定方法</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onChartEvent</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">event: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, handler: (params: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) =&gt; {
  chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(event, handler);
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">offChartEvent</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">event: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, handler: (params: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) =&gt; {
  chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">off</span>(event, handler);
};
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-8">如何使用？</h2>
<p>用起来超级简单，三步到位：</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">1. 基础使用</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">&lt;template&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ref</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"chartRef"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">class</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"chart-container"</span>&gt;</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/template&gt;

<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">script</span> <span class="hljs-attr">setup</span>&gt;</span><span class="javascript">
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEchart } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./useEchart'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 图表容器</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> chartRef = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 初始配置</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> option = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">xAxis</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'category'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'Mon'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'Tue'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'Wed'</span>] },
  <span class="hljs-attr">yAxis</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'value'</span> },
  <span class="hljs-attr">series</span>: [{ <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: [<span class="hljs-number">120</span>, <span class="hljs-number">200</span>, <span class="hljs-number">150</span>], <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'line'</span> }]
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化图表</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { chart, update } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useEchart</span>(chartRef, option.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>);
</span><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">script</span>&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">2. 事件绑定</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// 绑定点击事件</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { onChartEvent } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useEchart</span>(chartRef, option.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>);

<span class="hljs-title function_">onChartEvent</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">params</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'点击了图表'</span>, params);
});
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">3. 动态更新数据</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// 直接更新配置</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { update } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useEchart</span>(chartRef, option.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 按钮点击更新数据</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleUpdate</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">series</span>: [{ <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: [<span class="hljs-number">300</span>, <span class="hljs-number">150</span>, <span class="hljs-number">280</span>], <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'line'</span> }]
  });
};
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-12">为什么这个 Hooks 值得复用？</h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>减少重复代码</strong>：将通用逻辑抽象，每个图表只需关注配置和业务逻辑</li>
<li><strong>边界处理完善</strong>：包含容器不存在、重复初始化等异常情况处理</li>
<li><strong>灵活性高</strong>：支持多种容器形式，适应不同场景</li>
<li><strong>内存安全</strong>：自动清理事件和实例，避免内存泄漏</li>
<li><strong>响应式友好</strong>：完美配合 Vue 的响应式系统，数据变化自动更新图表</li>
</ol>
<h2 data-id="heading-13">最后</h2>
<p>这个<code>useEchart</code>&nbsp;Hooks 已经在我们项目中大规模使用，极大提升了开发效率。如果你也经常和 ECharts 打交道，不妨试试这个封装思路，也可以根据自己的需求扩展更多功能（比如主题切换、加载状态等）。</p>
<p>完整代码已经放在开头，直接复制就能用，有任何优化建议欢迎在评论区交流～</p>
<p>觉得有用的话别忘了点赞收藏，关注我获取更多前端实用工具封装技巧！</p></div></div>
